jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
jobs.content:
ExampleCo is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Backend team. You will design and build scalable services powering our core platform.

Requirements: 5+ years experience, strong knowledge of distributed systems, Go or Java.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Growth
jobs.content:
We're hiring a Product Manager to lead our Growth pod. You'll partner with engineering, design, and marketing to drive activation and retention.

Requirements: 3+ years PM experience, data-driven mindset.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.content:
Join our Analytics team as a Data Analyst. You will build dashboards and drive insights for cross-functional stakeholders.

Requirements: SQL, Python, experience with BI tools.
